::: {.lead}
`timescales` organizes the time dimension of model data: build nested
calendars — from annual to hourly, typical periods, and fiscal years —
keep your tables as tables while they gain calendar structure, convert
values between any two resolutions with conserved totals, sample partial
years, and see every level of a design at once. The R implementation is
active; a C++ core and Python bindings are in development.
:::
